Services

1. What are Ignite Services?
  • Ignite Services allow you to deploy managed, user-defined services on the cluster;
  • Services are automatically deployed, redeployed on node failure, and managed by Ignite;
  • Think of them as microservices that live inside the Ignite cluster;
2. Service Deployment Types
TypeDescription
Cluster Singleton Exactly one instance in the entire cluster; automatically redeployed if the hosting node fails;
Node Singleton One instance per node;
Key Affinity Deployed on the node that owns a specific affinity key;
Custom Deploy a specific number of instances across the cluster;
3. Implementing a Service
  • public class CounterService implements Service {
    private String name;
    private AtomicInteger counter = new AtomicInteger(0);

    @Override
    public void cancel(ServiceContext ctx) {
        System.out.println("Service " + ctx.name() + " cancelled");
    }

    @Override
    public void init(ServiceContext ctx) {
        name = ctx.name();
        System.out.println("Service " + name + " initialized");
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(ServiceContext ctx) {
        System.out.println("Service " + name + " executing");
    }

    public int increment() {
        return counter.incrementAndGet();
    }

    public int get() {
        return counter.get();
    }
}
4. Deploying Services
  • // Cluster singleton
ignite.services().deployClusterSingleton("counterService", new CounterService());

// Node singleton (one per node)
ignite.services().deployNodeSingleton("nodeCounter", new CounterService());

// Key affinity (on the node owning key=42 in "myCache")
ignite.services().deployKeyAffinitySingleton("affinityCounter",
    new CounterService(), "myCache", 42);

// Custom: 3 instances total, max 1 per node
ignite.services().deploy(
    new ServiceConfiguration()
        .setName("customCounter")
        .setService(new CounterService())
        .setTotalCount(3)
        .setMaxPerNodeCount(1)
);
5. Calling Services
  • // Get a proxy to the service
CounterService counter = ignite.services()
    .serviceProxy("counterService", CounterService.class, false);

counter.increment();
int value = counter.get();
  • The sticky parameter (last argument): if true, all calls go to the same node; if false, calls are load-balanced;
